hooks.command: dir="$PWD"; while [ "$dir" != "/" ] && [ ! -f "$dir/.claude/hooks/hook-dispatch.mjs" ]; do dir="$(dirname "$dir")"; done; if [ ! -f "$dir/.claude/hooks/hook-dispatch.mjs" ]; then echo "Tastile hook dispatcher not found" >&2; exit 2; fi; exec bun "$dir/.claude/hooks/hook-dispatch.mjs" codex
hooks.commandWindows: pwsh -NoProfile -Command '& { $dir = (Get-Location).Path; while ($dir -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir ".claude\hooks\hook-dispatch.mjs") -PathType Leaf)) { $parent = Split-Path -Parent $dir; if ($parent -eq $dir) { $dir = $null; break }; $dir = $parent }; if (-not $dir) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("Tastile hook dispatcher not found"); exit 2 }; & bun (Join-Path $dir ".claude\hooks\hook-dispatch.mjs") codex; exit $LASTEXITCODE }'
